_about: Soundcore models SoundPeter knows. model is Soundcore's model number, which the earbuds' vendor service UUID and serial number carry. ldac_excludes lists features that LDAC turns off on the earbuds, as seen on hardware; ids are SoundPeter's (data/soundpeats/commands.json). reports lists recordings in data/soundcore/reports.

notes: LDAC on turns two devices off, and LDAC off turns it back on. With LDAC off, two devices can be turned off and on by itself.
Every LDAC or two-devices change makes the earbuds restart their connection; the control channel closes and can be opened again a few seconds later.
